newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal sets repo, leaves rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal sets repo, leaves rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal offered to inject 10 billion escudos into the money market in a variable rate repurchase pact and said that it had left its draining and emergency rates unchanged.
The draining rate remains at 6.20 percent and the emergency lending rate at 8.30 percent.
Bids in the repo must be submitted by 1515 GMT. The central bank previously injected funds at 6.50 percent.
